name: GPU-based Shear-Warp
definition: A GPU implementation of the Shear-Warp algorithm using vertex and fragment shaders for real-time rendering.
summary: GPU-based Shear-Warp is a hardware-accelerated volume rendering method that decomposes viewing transformations into shear, projection, and warp steps for real-time performance, though it is slower than GPU-based Ray Marching.
